title: R104Q · MD replicates
hypothesis: R104Q destabilizes the NTD core; D84N rescues it.

funnel.label: Structure & mechanism
funnel.caveat: A crystal structure is a static snapshot, not proof of dynamics.

funnel.label: Variant scoring
funnel.caveat: Predictors agree R104Q is damaging, but they don't give a mechanism.

funnel.label: Static models WT/mut/rescue
funnel.caveat: Minimized models are starting points; behavior only shows under MD.

funnel.label: Flagship MD (n=1)
funnel.caveat: A single replicate can be a lucky trajectory — needs repeats.

funnel.label: MD replicates (n=3)
funnel.caveat: This is where a real signal separates from noise.

funnel.label: FEP ΔΔG_fold
funnel.caveat: FEP is rigorous but sensitive to setup; convergence must be checked.

funnel.label: Chaperone re-rank (DiffDock)
funnel.caveat: Docking ranks poses, it does not prove binding in a cell.

funnel.label: SIMULATION WALL
funnel.caveat: Everything above is what a GPU can tell you. Nothing below is.

funnel.label: Wet-lab: patch-clamp / trafficking
funnel.caveat: Only a wet lab can confirm the functional consequence.

funnel.label: Clinical
funnel.detail: ICD already protects — the real safeguard today
funnel.caveat: Compute never reaches here. An ICD is the current standard of care.
